title: A Rainy Weekend
description: Ben finds fun things to do when it rains all weekend.
instructions: Read about Ben's rainy weekend. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🌧️ It rained all weekend in Ben's town. On Saturday morning, he looked out of the window. The streets were wet and the sky was dark.
Ben was not happy at first. He wanted to play football with his friends. His mum said, 'You must stay at home today.'
So Ben and his sister Mai played a board game. Mai won three times! Then they made a big pizza with cheese and tomatoes.
On Sunday, the rain was lighter. Ben put on his coat and boots. He and his dad walked to the library.
📚 Ben borrowed two books about dinosaurs. He read one of them in the afternoon. It was very interesting.
In the evening, the rain stopped and Ben saw a rainbow. 'Next weekend, we can play football,' he said. He smiled.
